data.narrative: Completed Module 7 runbooks and documentation - chose simple linear runbook style for 3 AM on-call scenarios. Sleep-deprived engineers need no-decision runbooks that work like a checklist. Created runbook with exact copy-paste commands for database down, cache failure, API timeout scenarios. Added expected outputs and escalation criteria (10 minutes to senior engineer, page SRE for critical). Fixed missing commands, log paths, and escalation thresholds.
